WITH b AS (SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", e."EquipType", ls."lifeSupportStat", ls."O2SupplyStat", ls."medEquipStat", ls."safetySysStat",
 CASE WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / om."maintCycleHrs") WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / om."maintCycleHrs") ELSE 0 END AS ors,
 CASE t."insulationStat" WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t."heatLoss_kwh" / 10 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t."heatLoss_kwh" / 10 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t."heatLoss_kwh" / 10 END AS tie
 FROM "Equipment" e JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE" JOIN "PowerBattery" p ON p.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE" JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.batt_link = p."PWR_BATT_ID" WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Safety')
SELECT "EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, "EquipType" AS equipment_type, "lifeSupportStat" AS life_support_status, ROUND((0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie)::numeric, 2) AS lssr,
 CASE WHEN 0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability' WHEN 0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie >= 0.6 THEN 'Moderate Reliability' WHEN 0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie < 0.6 THEN 'Low Reliability' END AS reliability_classification,
 jsonb_build_object('oxygen_status', "O2SupplyStat", 'medical_status', "medEquipStat", 'safety_system_status', "safetySysStat") AS support_systems_status
FROM b ORDER BY lssr DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS extreme_weather_ready_shelters FROM "Equipment" e
LEFT JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ws.opmaint_link = om."OP_MAINT_ID"
LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce ON ce."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "PowerBattery" p ON p.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.batt_link = p."PWR_BATT_ID"
WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Shelter' AND ((100 - ws."structLoadPct")/100.0 * CASE WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END) > 0.7 AND ce.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' <> 'Off' AND t."insulationStat" <> 'Good' AND ls."emerLightStat" IN ('On', 'Testing')

SELECT c."CHASSIS_ID" AS chassis_registry_id,
 (1 - ((c.ground_vehicle_status->'brake_system'->>'pad_wear_pct')::numeric + (c.ground_vehicle_status->'tracks'->>'wear_pct')::numeric) / 200)
 * (split_part(c.ground_vehicle_status->'vehicle_motion'->>'speed_kmh', ' ', 1)::numeric / 50)
 * ((e.engine_fluids_snapshot->'engine_core'->>'load_pct')::numeric / 100) AS vpc
FROM "ChassisAndVehicle" c LEFT JOIN "EngineAndFluids" e ON e."ENGINE_ID" = c.engine_link

SELECT "OP_MAINT_ID" AS registry_id, "OPER_hours" AS operation_hours, "maintCycleHrs" AS maintenance_cycle_hours, "OPER_status" AS operational_status,
 CASE WHEN "OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - "OPER_hours" / "maintCycleHrs") WHEN "OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - "OPER_hours" / "maintCycleHrs") ELSE 0 END AS ors
FROM "OperationMaintenance"

SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, e."EquipType" AS equipment_type, ce.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' AS heater_status, t."insulationStat" AS insulation_status, ls."emerLightStat" AS emergency_light_status,
 ROUND(((100 - ws."structLoadPct")/100.0 * CASE WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END)::numeric, 2) AS ssf,
 CASE WHEN ((100 - ws."structLoadPct")/100.0 * CASE WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5 WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8 ELSE 1.0 END) > 0.7 AND ce.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' <> 'Off' AND t."insulationStat" <> 'Poor' AND ls."emerLightStat" IN ('On', 'Testing') THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready' ELSE 'Not Ready' END AS extreme_weather_readiness_status
FROM "Equipment" e
JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ws.opmaint_link = om."OP_MAINT_ID"
LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce ON ce."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "PowerBattery" p ON p.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.batt_link = p."PWR_BATT_ID"

WITH c AS (SELECT loc_link, "equipRef", CASE antenna_stat WHEN 'Error' THEN 0 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END * (1 - "netLatency_ms" / 1000.0) AS cri, "radioSignal_dBm" AS r, "netLatency_ms" AS l
 FROM "Communication" WHERE antenna_stat IS NOT NULL AND "netLatency_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "radioSignal_dBm" IS NOT NULL),
b AS (SELECT *, cri * (1 + 0.2 * r / 100) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - l)) AS bscsi FROM c),
s AS (SELECT loc_link, AVG(cri) AS acri, AVG(bscsi) AS abscsi, string_agg("equipRef", ', ' ORDER BY "equipRef") AS eq FROM b GROUP BY loc_link)
SELECT loc_link AS station_name, ROUND(acri::numeric, 2) AS avg_cri, ROUND(abscsi::numeric, 2) AS avg_bscsi, eq AS contributing_equipment
FROM s WHERE NOT (acri > 0.8 AND abscsi > 0.85) AND NOT (acri > 0.6 AND abscsi > 0.7)
ORDER BY abscsi ASC

SELECT l."locType" AS location_type, l."STATION_name" AS station_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c."equipRef") AS equipment_count,
 ROUND(AVG((t."solarOutput_w" + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) / (t."fuelCellOutput_w" + t."solarOutput_w" + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS rec, SUM(COALESCE(t."solarOutput_w", 0) + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) AS total_renewable_output_w,
 CASE WHEN AVG((t."solarOutput_w" + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) / (t."fuelCellOutput_w" + t."solarOutput_w" + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) * 100) > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable' WHEN AVG((t."solarOutput_w" + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) / (t."fuelCellOutput_w" + t."solarOutput_w" + COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)) * 100) > 50 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable' ELSE 'Low Sustainability' END AS sustainability_classification
FROM "Location" l JOIN "Communication" c ON c.loc_link = l."STATION_name" JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.comm_link = c."COMM_ID"
WHERE t."solarOutput_w" IS NOT NULL OR t."windOutput_w" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l."locType", l."STATION_name" ORDER BY rec DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT e."EquipType", e."EQUIP_CODE",
 ((et.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric) / 2 * (1 - (et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100) AS eer,
 (et.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::numeric AS safety_index
 FROM "Equipment" e JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON et."EquipType" = e."EquipType"),
r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "EquipType" ORDER BY eer DESC) AS efficiency_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "EquipType" ORDER BY safety_index DESC) AS safety_rank FROM b)
SELECT "EquipType" AS equipment_type, "EQUIP_CODE" AS equipment_code, ROUND(eer, 2) AS eer, safety_index, efficiency_rank, safety_rank, ABS(efficiency_rank - safety_rank) AS rank_difference
FROM r ORDER BY "EquipType", eer DESC

WITH es AS (SELECT DISTINCT eq, st FROM (SELECT "equipRef" AS eq, loc_link AS st FROM "Communication" UNION SELECT "equipRef", loc_link FROM "CabinEnvironment" UNION SELECT om."equipRef", ws.loc_link FROM "WeatherAndStructure" ws JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."OP_MAINT_ID" = ws.opmaint_link) u WHERE eq IS NOT NULL AND st IS NOT NULL)
SELECT l."STATION_name" AS station_name, w."waterQualityIdx" AS water_quality_index, w."waterLevelPct" AS water_level_percent,
 CASE WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 THEN 'Good' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 26 THEN 'Poor' WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" < 26 THEN 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification
FROM "Location" l LEFT JOIN es ON es.st = l."STATION_name" LEFT JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = es.eq
ORDER BY l."STATION_name"

WITH es AS (SELECT DISTINCT eq, st FROM (SELECT "equipRef" AS eq, loc_link AS st FROM "Communication" UNION SELECT "equipRef", loc_link FROM "CabinEnvironment" UNION SELECT om."equipRef", ws.loc_link FROM "WeatherAndStructure" ws JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."OP_MAINT_ID" = ws.opmaint_link) u WHERE eq IS NOT NULL AND st IS NOT NULL),
b AS (SELECT l."STATION_name", l."locType", w."waterQualityIdx" AS wqi, (w."waterLevelPct" / 100.0) * (w."waterQualityIdx" / 100.0) * (1 - w."wasteTankPct" / 100.0) AS wrmi
 FROM "Location" l JOIN es ON es.st = l."STATION_name" JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = es.eq),
g AS (SELECT "STATION_name", "locType", AVG(wqi) AS awqi, AVG(wrmi) AS awrmi, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wrmi < 0.5) AS conservation_needed_count FROM b GROUP BY "STATION_name", "locType")
SELECT "STATION_name" AS station_name, "locType" AS location_type, ROUND(awqi::numeric, 2) AS avg_water_quality_index, ROUND(awrmi::numeric, 2) AS avg_wrmi, conservation_needed_count,
 CASE WHEN awqi >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality' WHEN awqi >= 71 THEN 'Good' WHEN awqi >= 51 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN awqi >= 26 THEN 'Poor' WHEN awqi < 26 THEN 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification,
 CASE WHEN awrmi < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed' WHEN awrmi < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised' ELSE 'Sustainable Management' END AS water_resource_management_status
FROM g ORDER BY awrmi DESC, awqi DESC
